end.parentNote: Asha practised matching quantities and number names to numerals with Aarav. They used fingers and claps to show amounts, and later connected “aath” with 8 and “zero” with 0 and “kuch nahi.” There was some uncertainty while identifying 4, 8, and 9; the zero mix-up was corrected after it was seen earlier (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, show a small group of 1–9 objects and ask Aarav to say the number and write its numeral.
